messages:
alex: Hey team — need a quick 30m sync to run through TenantX Dedicated rollout (VPC peering, certs, canary, rollback). Available windows: Tue 09:00–11:00 PT, Wed 16:00–18:00 PT. Thoughts? Please add any agenda items.

maria: Tue 09:30 PT works for me. Add 'verify customer firewall / egress IPs' and 'KMS / HSM key access'.

devon: Wed evening is better for me but I can make Tue if we record. Also want to confirm approach for model pinning during canary (how long, traffic steps).

samir: +1 to model pinning. Can we include an A/B traffic split proposal? e.g., 5/95 -> 25/75 -> 50/50. Also confirm SLOs we’ll watch (p95/p99 latency).

alex: Proposed agenda:
1) Rollout timeline & owners
2) VPC peering & network checks (egress IPs) — @maria
3) Certs & KMS access — @lina
4) Canary plan & model pinning — @devon
5) Metrics & alerting check (latency / cost) — @samir
6) Rollback criteria & comms

If Tue 09:30 PT OK I'll book the 30m slot, create a calendar invite and attach the runbook. If not, pick Wed 16:30 PT.

lina: Need the customer to provide KMS key ARN and accept our IAM role. Please ask them to provide the key 48h ahead. IAM trust policy we need (paste for their infra team):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMSRelay"},
      "Action": "kms:Decrypt"
    }
  ]
}
```

Can we make that a hard prereq?

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: TenantX Dedicated Rollout Review — Tue 2027-03-15 09:30 PT — invite sent to participants.

maria: quick network check: customer firewall will only allow outbound to our static egress IPs — list they provided: 34.201.10.5, 3.92.44.1. @alex please confirm these are still the right IPs for the region.

alex: Confirmed for this region; adding to invite notes. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenantx-dedicated-rollout (will attach checklist).

devon: I'll prepare the model-pinning PR and add the canary traffic config snippet: 
```yaml
canary:
  traffic_split: 0.05
  duration_minutes: 30
```
I'll link the PR in the invite so reviewers can skim beforehand.

samir: One more ops item: who is on-call during the deployment? Suggest primary = oncall-sre, secondary = eng-platform. Also enable staged autoscaling for the first hour.

alex: Good call. I'll set primary/secondary in the invite and flag autoscaling. Anything else before I book?

lina: Please confirm HSM access with compliance — I'll loop in legal and send the justification template.

maria: all set from my side, thanks. See you Tue :thumbsup:

alex: Great — calendar invite sent with checklist and links. Thanks everyone.
